verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP/CLI docs describe agent connections as granting 'full access to read and update your Kick data' (kick-docs-27) and 'full control' (kick-docs-26), not scoped or least-privilege credentials. RBAC (kick-docs-11) governs human team member permissions in the workspace, not per-agent API credential scoping, and there is no documentation of issuing limited-scope tokens/keys for AI agents.
